title: The user's name and how to address her
body:
## Knowledge
The user is Lin Wei (林薇). She uses she/her and likes to be called Wei in chat.
## Evidence and limits
Stated by the user herself when she set up the assistant.
## Recheck when
She asks to be addressed differently.

title: 用户住在杭州
body:
## Knowledge
林薇住在杭州西湖区，时区是 Asia/Shanghai（UTC+8）。
## Evidence and limits
用户自己说的；具体街道没有记录。
## Recheck when
她提到搬家。

title: The user's birthday
body:
## Knowledge
Lin Wei was born on 14 March 1991.
## Evidence and limits
Stated by the user; year confirmed when she mentioned turning 35 in 2026.
## Recheck when
Never expected to change.

title: The user's current job at Quillpay
body:
## Knowledge
Lin Wei is a backend engineer at Quillpay, a fintech start-up in Hangzhou, since September 2021.
She is on the Ledger Platform team; her manager is Priya Raman.
## Evidence and limits
Stated by the user. Title and team are as of January 2026.
## Recheck when
She mentions a promotion, a team change or a new employer.

title: 用户之前在 Norden Labs 工作
body:
## Knowledge
2016 年到 2021 年，林薇在上海的 Norden Labs 做数据工程师，主要用 Python 和 Spark。
## Evidence and limits
用户在聊简历时说的。
## Recheck when
她补充这段经历的细节。

title: The user's partner Tomas
body:
## Knowledge
Lin Wei's partner is Tomas Lindqvist, who is Swedish and works as a UX designer.
Tomas's birthday is 10 August.
## Evidence and limits
Stated by the user when planning a birthday dinner in 2026.
## Recheck when
She corrects any of it.

title: 用户的狗 Mochi
body:
## Knowledge
林薇养了一只柯基，叫 Mochi（麻糬），2022 年领养的。她每天早上七点遛狗。
## Evidence and limits
用户提到过多次；狗的体重和生日没有记录。
## Recheck when
遛狗时间变化。

title: Editor: vim (until June 2026)
body:
## Knowledge
Until the start of June 2026 Lin Wei's editor was vim, with a plain vimrc and no plugin manager.
## Evidence and limits
Her stated preference from January to May 2026. Replaced by Helix in June 2026.
## Recheck when
Historical only.

title: Editor: Helix (since June 2026)
body:
## Knowledge
Since June 2026 Lin Wei's editor is Helix (`hx`). She uses its default keymap and the Gruvbox theme.
Before that she used vim.
## Evidence and limits
Stated by the user on 3 June 2026 after two weeks of trying Helix.
## Recheck when
She mentions switching editors again.

title: Dark mode and Gruvbox everywhere
body:
## Knowledge
Lin Wei wants dark mode in every app. Her editor theme is Gruvbox Dark and her coding font is JetBrains Mono at 13 pt.
## Evidence and limits
Stated preference; applies to the terminal, editor and any generated screenshots.
## Recheck when
She asks for a different theme.

title: 喝茶不喝咖啡
body:
## Knowledge
林薇只喝茶，不喝咖啡。最喜欢龙井。下午三点以后不喝任何含咖啡因的饮料。
## Evidence and limits
用户自己说的。
## Recheck when
她提到开始喝咖啡。

title: How the user wants answers written
body:
## Knowledge
Lin Wei wants concise answers. Summaries as bullet lists. No emoji. Code in fenced blocks with a language tag.
## Evidence and limits
Stated preference, repeated twice.
## Recheck when
She asks for longer or more formal answers.

title: 中文闲聊，英文写技术内容
body:
## Knowledge
和林薇闲聊用中文；代码评审、技术文档和 commit message 用英文。数字一律用阿拉伯数字。
## Evidence and limits
用户明确要求的。
## Recheck when
她要求改变语言。

title: Commit message style
body:
## Knowledge
Commits follow Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:` …), an imperative subject of at most 72 characters,
no emoji anywhere in the message, and a body wrapped at 72 columns.
## Evidence and limits
Stated preference; applies to every repository she works in.
## Recheck when
A project she joins has its own convention.

title: Code formatting preferences
body:
## Knowledge
4-space indentation, a maximum line width of 100, trailing commas in multi-line literals, and early returns over nested ifs.
## Evidence and limits
Stated preference for the code the assistant writes; a project formatter wins when one exists.
## Recheck when
She mentions a formatter change.

title: Database preference: PostgreSQL
body:
## Knowledge
Lin Wei prefers PostgreSQL for anything new and avoids MongoDB. She uses `psql` from the terminal rather than a GUI client.
## Evidence and limits
Stated preference.
## Recheck when
A project forces another database.

title: Python tooling: uv and ruff
body:
## Knowledge
For Python she uses `uv` (not pip or poetry) for environments and dependencies, and `ruff` for both linting and formatting.
Python 3.13 is her default interpreter.
## Evidence and limits
Stated preference in February 2026.
## Recheck when
She mentions another tool.

title: 周回顾：周五下午四点
body:
## Knowledge
林薇每周五下午 16:00 做周回顾，需要一份本周完成事项的列表。
## Evidence and limits
2026 年 1 月记录的。
## Recheck when
她改时间。

title: 周回顾：周一上午九点半
body:
## Knowledge
林薇每周一上午 9:30 做周回顾。她要一份上周任务的 bullet 摘要，按项目分组，先 Lantern 后 Moss。
## Evidence and limits
2026 年 4 月用户说的。
## Recheck when
她改时间或格式。

title: Standing rule: never push to main directly
body:
## Knowledge
Nothing is ever pushed to `main` directly, in any repository. Every change, documentation included, goes through a pull request.
## Evidence and limits
A standing instruction from the user, restated after an accidental push in 2025.
## Recheck when
She lifts the rule explicitly.

title: Personal cloud budget
body:
## Knowledge
Personal cloud spending is capped at 200 USD per month across Cloudflare and one Hetzner VPS, with a warning at 150 USD.
## Evidence and limits
Decided by the user in February 2026.
## Recheck when
She raises or lowers the cap.

title: Shellfish allergy
body:
## Knowledge
Lin Wei has a severe shellfish allergy: no shrimp, crab, lobster or oysters. Peanuts and tree nuts are fine.
## Evidence and limits
Stated by the user; relevant to any restaurant or recipe suggestion.
## Recheck when
Never expected to change.

title: 跑步计划和半马目标
body:
## Knowledge
林薇每周二和周六跑 5 公里，目前配速 6'10"/km。目标是 2026 年 11 月的杭州马拉松半程。
## Evidence and limits
用户 2026 年 3 月说的；配速会变。
## Recheck when
比赛结束或者计划改变。

title: Reading taste: science fiction
body:
## Knowledge
Lin Wei reads mostly science fiction. Favourite authors: Ted Chiang and Liu Cixin. Her reading notes are published on Moss.
## Evidence and limits
Stated preference.
## Recheck when
She mentions a new favourite.

title: Laptop: ThinkPad X1 Carbon on Fedora (until November 2025)
body:
## Knowledge
Until mid-November 2025 Lin Wei's laptop was a ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 9 running Fedora.
## Evidence and limits
Historical; replaced by a MacBook Air M3.
## Recheck when
Historical only.

title: Laptop: MacBook Air M3 (since November 2025)
body:
## Knowledge
Since November 2025 Lin Wei works on a MacBook Air M3 with 16 GB of memory, running macOS. Before that she used a ThinkPad on Fedora.
## Evidence and limits
Stated by the user; the M3 is Apple silicon (arm64), which matters for toolchains.
## Recheck when
She mentions a new machine.

title: GitHub handle
body:
## Knowledge
Lin Wei's GitHub handle is `linwei-dev`. Her work organisation on GitHub is `quillpay`.
## Evidence and limits
Stated by the user.
## Recheck when
She renames the account.

title: 键盘：HHKB，Caps Lock 映射为 Ctrl
body:
## Knowledge
林薇用 HHKB Professional Hybrid Type-S 键盘，Caps Lock 映射成 Ctrl，用 QWERTY 布局。
## Evidence and limits
用户说的。
## Recheck when
她换键盘。

title: 学日语，目标 N3
body:
## Knowledge
林薇在学日语，目标是 2026 年 12 月考过 JLPT N3。每天用 Anki 复习 20 分钟，周四晚上跟 Sato 老师上课。
## Evidence and limits
用户 2026 年 2 月说的。
## Recheck when
考试结束或者课程变化。

title: 以前开本田飞度（2026 年 4 月卖掉）
body:
## Knowledge
林薇以前开一辆 2018 年的本田飞度，2026 年 4 月 20 日卖掉了。
## Evidence and limits
历史信息；卖车后改坐地铁。
## Recheck when
仅作历史。

title: 现在坐地铁 5 号线通勤
body:
## Knowledge
2026 年 4 月卖掉车之后，林薇坐地铁 5 号线通勤，从西湖区到滨江区的公司大约 40 分钟。
## Evidence and limits
用户说的。
## Recheck when
她搬家或换工作。

title: 每周日去山姆采购
body:
## Knowledge
林薇每周日去山姆会员店采购一周的东西。常买的：农夫山泉、燕麦、无糖酸奶。
## Evidence and limits
用户说的习惯。
## Recheck when
她提到换地方。

title: 父母在宁波
body:
## Knowledge
林薇的父母住在宁波，她每个月回去一次。母亲叫陈红，父亲叫林建国。
## Evidence and limits
用户说的。
## Recheck when
父母搬家。

title: Doctor and annual check-up
body:
## Knowledge
Lin Wei's GP is Dr. Qian Ming at Zhejiang Provincial People's Hospital. She has an annual check-up every October and takes no regular medication.
## Evidence and limits
Stated by the user.
## Recheck when
She mentions a new doctor or a prescription.

title: Passport expiry
body:
## Knowledge
Lin Wei's passport expires on 18 February 2027. She wants to start the renewal by November 2026.
## Evidence and limits
Stated by the user.
## Recheck when
After the renewal.

title: Notes live in Obsidian; Notion was declined
body:
## Knowledge
In February 2026 Lin Wei declined moving to Notion, for privacy and offline access. Her notes live in an Obsidian vault at `~/Vault`, with a daily-notes template.
## Evidence and limits
Her decision; the assistant should not suggest Notion again.
## Recheck when
She raises the question herself.

title: Neovim migration abandoned (October 2025)
body:
## Knowledge
In October 2025 Lin Wei tried migrating from vim to Neovim with a Lua config. She abandoned it after two weeks because of plugin churn and went back to vim (and later to Helix).
## Evidence and limits
Told by the user in January 2026.
## Recheck when
She wants to try Neovim again.

title: Résumé draft requested, then cancelled (June 2026)
body:
## Knowledge
On 2 June 2026 Lin Wei asked for a résumé draft for a backend role in Singapore. On 3 June she cancelled it: she decided to stay at Quillpay through 2027. No résumé was produced.
## Evidence and limits
Both messages are in the transcript.
## Recheck when
She asks about job applications again.

title: 拒绝了批量删除过期分支的建议（2026-08-15）
body:
## Knowledge
2026 年 8 月 15 日，助手建议删掉 lantern 仓库里 30 多个已合并的过期分支。林薇拒绝了：她要自己先归档分支列表，之后再说。什么都没删。
## Evidence and limits
对话记录里有。
## Recheck when
她主动要求清理。

title: 订餐厅失败（2026-07-09）
body:
## Knowledge
2026 年 7 月 9 日林薇让助手订"绿茶餐厅"周五晚上两个人的位子。助手没有任何预订接口，操作失败了。她后来自己在大众点评上订好了。
## Evidence and limits
对话记录里有；助手至今没有订餐能力。
## Recheck when
接入了预订工具。

title: Stockholm trip in October 2026
body:
## Knowledge
Lin Wei will be in Stockholm from 5 to 19 October 2026 visiting Tomas's family. During that window meetings should be scheduled in CET (UTC+1 after the clocks change on 25 October is not relevant; the trip ends before).
## Evidence and limits
Stated by the user in August 2026.
## Recheck when
After 19 October 2026, or if the dates move.

title: Music while coding
body:
## Knowledge
Lin Wei listens to lo-fi while coding and to nothing during meetings. She uses Apple Music, having moved off Spotify in March 2026.
## Evidence and limits
Stated preference.
## Recheck when
She mentions another service.

title: 作息：23:30 睡，6:30 起
body:
## Knowledge
林薇通常 23:30 睡觉，6:30 起床。上午 9:30 之前不安排会议。
## Evidence and limits
用户说的习惯。
## Recheck when
她说作息变了。

title: Two-factor: YubiKey
body:
## Knowledge
Lin Wei uses a YubiKey 5C as the second factor for GitHub and 1Password. A backup key is kept at home. She does not use SMS codes.
## Evidence and limits
Stated by the user; no key material is recorded here.
## Recheck when
She changes her security setup.

title: Shell: fish with starship
body:
## Knowledge
Lin Wei's shell is fish with the starship prompt. She uses `zoxide` for directory jumping and has `gs` aliased to `git status`.
## Evidence and limits
Stated preference; scripts she asks for should still be POSIX sh or bash, not fish.
## Recheck when
She changes shells.

title: 耳机：Sony WH-1000XM5
body:
## Knowledge
林薇用 Sony WH-1000XM5 耳机；2026 年 5 月换过左边的耳罩。
## Evidence and limits
用户说的。
## Recheck when
她换耳机。

title: Lantern: Quillpay's ledger-reconciliation service
body:
## Knowledge
Lantern (灯笼) is Quillpay's ledger-reconciliation service, written in Rust. Repository: `github.com/quillpay/lantern`.
Owned by the Ledger Platform team; in production since September 2025.
## Evidence and limits
From the repository README and the user.
## Recheck when
The service is split or renamed.

title: Lantern build, test and lint commands
body:
## Knowledge
Build: `cargo build --workspace`. Test: `cargo nextest run --workspace`. Lint: `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`.
Format check: `cargo fmt --check`. Run locally: `just run` (listens on port 8790).
## Evidence and limits
From the repository's `justfile` and CI; verified in January 2026.
## Recheck when
The justfile or CI changes.

title: Lantern deployment
body:
## Knowledge
Staging: `just deploy staging`, which needs the VPN and `LANTERN_DEPLOY_TOKEN` from the 1Password vault "Lantern-dev" (never typed into the shell history).
Production: only through the GitHub Actions `release` workflow, triggered by a `v*` tag. There is no manual production deploy.
## Evidence and limits
From the runbook; verified with the user in February 2026.
## Recheck when
The release workflow changes.

title: Lantern 分支和 PR 规范
body:
## Knowledge
分支命名 `lw/<topic>`。每个 PR 至少一个 reviewer，通常是 Priya。合并用 squash merge。默认分支是 `main`（2026 年 2 月从 `master` 改名）。
## Evidence and limits
仓库 CONTRIBUTING.md 和用户说明。
## Recheck when
规范改了。

title: Lantern database migrations
body:
## Knowledge
Migrations use sqlx: apply with `sqlx migrate run`, create with `sqlx migrate add -r <name>` (reversible). They live in `migrations/`.
Never edit a migration that has already been applied anywhere; add a new one.
## Evidence and limits
Team rule; from the user.
## Recheck when
The migration tool changes.

title: Lantern 本地环境
body:
## Knowledge
本地配置放在 `.env.local`（git-ignored）。本地数据库 URL 是 `postgres://lantern:lantern@localhost:5433/lantern_dev`。
起依赖：`docker compose -f compose.dev.yml up -d`（Postgres 16 和一个假的 partner API）。
## Evidence and limits
用户 2026 年 3 月确认。
## Recheck when
compose 文件改了。

title: Money is Decimal, never f64
body:
## Knowledge
All money in Lantern is `rust_decimal::Decimal`. Floating point is forbidden for amounts. Decided on 12 May 2026 after a rounding incident in batch #4471.
## Evidence and limits
Team decision recorded in ADR-007 of the repository.
## Recheck when
Never expected to change.

title: Lantern moved from diesel to sqlx (March 2026)
body:
## Knowledge
In March 2026 Lantern switched its database layer from diesel to sqlx, for async support and compile-time checked queries. New code must not use diesel.
## Evidence and limits
Completed on 10 March 2026; the last diesel module was removed in PR #188.
## Recheck when
Never expected to reverse.

title: Kafka 提案被否决（2026 年 7 月）
body:
## Knowledge
2026 年 7 月，Priya 提议给 Lantern 引入 Kafka 做事件流。团队否决了：改用 PostgreSQL 的 LISTEN/NOTIFY 加一张 outbox 表。年内不再重提 Kafka。
## Evidence and limits
团队会议决定，用户转述。
## Recheck when
2027 年之后，或者事件量超过 Postgres 能承受的范围。

title: nextest under Rosetta failed; use the native toolchain
body:
## Knowledge
In December 2025 `cargo nextest run` under Rosetta (an x86_64 toolchain on the M3) crashed with SIGILL inside `ring`.
The fix was to use the native `aarch64-apple-darwin` toolchain. Rosetta is not supported for Lantern.
## Evidence and limits
Reproduced by the user twice.
## Recheck when
The `ring` dependency is replaced.

title: The flaky test reconcile_partial_batch
body:
## Knowledge
`reconcile_partial_batch` is flaky (a timing race). It is `#[ignore]`d until issue #212 is fixed. Do not "fix" it by adding retries or sleeps.
## Evidence and limits
Team agreement; issue #212 is open as of September 2026.
## Recheck when
Issue #212 closes.

title: Lantern on-call 轮值
body:
## Knowledge
on-call 每周四换班。林薇的轮值周从 9 月 24 日和 10 月 22 日（2026 年）开始。告警从 PagerDuty 转到企业微信。
## Evidence and limits
排班表，2026 年 9 月。
## Recheck when
排班表更新。

title: Lantern release cadence and steps
body:
## Knowledge
Releases go out every second Wednesday. Steps: `just bump <patch|minor>`, changelog with `git cliff`, then push a `vX.Y.Z` tag, which triggers the release workflow.
## Evidence and limits
From the release runbook; matches the deploy note.
## Recheck when
The cadence changes.

title: Lantern SLOs
body:
## Knowledge
SLO: `/v1/reconcile` p95 latency under 120 ms and an error rate under 0.1 %. Dashboards live in the Grafana folder "Lantern".
## Evidence and limits
From the SLO document, 2026.
## Recheck when
The SLO document is revised.

title: Staging database: lantern_staging on pg-staging-1
body:
## Knowledge
The staging database is `lantern_staging` on host `pg-staging-1`.
## Evidence and limits
Recorded 2 March 2026 from the staging `.env`.
## Recheck when
The staging infrastructure moves.

title: Staging database: lantern_stg on pg-staging-2
body:
## Knowledge
After the June 2026 infrastructure move the staging database is `lantern_stg` on host `pg-staging-2`.
## Evidence and limits
Recorded 20 June 2026 from the updated runbook.
## Recheck when
The staging infrastructure moves again.

title: Rotating a partner API key
body:
## Knowledge
Run `just rotate-key <partner>`, store the new key in the 1Password vault "Lantern-dev", then post in `#lantern-ops`. Partner keys expire every 90 days.
## Evidence and limits
From the ops runbook.
## Recheck when
The rotation tooling changes.

title: Lantern 日志
body:
## Knowledge
日志是 JSON 格式（tracing-subscriber）。`request_id` 字段必须在所有下游调用里透传。本地看日志用 `just logs`；生产日志在 Loki。
## Evidence and limits
仓库文档。
## Recheck when
日志栈换了。

title: Lantern reviewers
body:
## Knowledge
Default reviewer: Priya Raman (`@priya-r`). Database migrations also need Chen Bo (`@chenbo`). Reviews are expected within one working day.
## Evidence and limits
Team convention, 2026.
## Recheck when
The team changes.

title: Lantern CI
body:
## Knowledge
CI is GitHub Actions `ci.yml` on `ubuntu-24.04`: build, nextest, clippy, fmt and `cargo deny`. A red `cargo deny` blocks the merge.
## Evidence and limits
From the workflow file, April 2026.
## Recheck when
The workflow changes.

title: Outbound retry policy
body:
## Knowledge
Outbound partner calls retry 3 times with exponential backoff (200 ms base, 2 s cap). The idempotency key is the ledger batch id.
## Evidence and limits
ADR-005 in the repository.
## Recheck when
A partner changes its idempotency contract.

title: Lantern secrets handling
body:
## Knowledge
Secrets are never committed in env files. `LANTERN_*` variables come from the 1Password CLI: `op run --env-file=.env.op -- just run`.
## Evidence and limits
Team rule.
## Recheck when
The secret manager changes.

title: Lantern listens on port 8080
body:
## Knowledge
The Lantern service listens on port 8080 locally.
## Evidence and limits
Recorded 1 October 2025 from the first README.
## Recheck when
The default port changes.

title: Lantern listens on port 8790
body:
## Knowledge
The Lantern service listens on port 8790 locally (moved off 8080 to stop clashing with the partner mock).
## Evidence and limits
Recorded 2 April 2026 from the justfile.
## Recheck when
The default port changes.

title: Moss（苔）：个人静态站点生成器
body:
## Knowledge
Moss（苔）是林薇的个人项目：一个用 Python 写的静态站点生成器，生成她的中文读书笔记博客 `moss.linwei.dev`。
仓库在 `~/code/moss`，GitHub 上是 `linwei-dev/moss`。
## Evidence and limits
用户介绍的。
## Recheck when
项目改名或者换语言。

title: Moss build, preview and test commands
body:
## Knowledge
Build: `uv run moss build` (writes `dist/`). Preview: `uv run moss serve --port 4000`. Tests: `uv run pytest -q`.
Lint and format: `ruff check .` and `ruff format`.
## Evidence and limits
From the README, updated May 2026 when the output directory became `dist/`.
## Recheck when
The CLI changes.

title: Moss deployment to Cloudflare Pages
body:
## Knowledge
Deploy with `wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name moss`. DNS is on Cloudflare. There is no CI: deploys are run from the laptop after `uv run moss build`.
## Evidence and limits
From the user, 2026.
## Recheck when
A CI pipeline is added.

title: Moss 内容格式
body:
## Knowledge
文章在 `content/notes/*.md`。front matter 字段：`title`、`date`、`tags`，可选 `book`。slug 用 `pypinyin` 从标题生成。
图片放在 `content/images/`，构建时用 Pillow 转成 WebP，最长边 1600 像素。
## Evidence and limits
仓库文档。
## Recheck when
内容格式改了。

title: Kept Jinja2; a hand-written template engine was rejected
body:
## Knowledge
In April 2026 Lin Wei considered replacing Jinja2 with a hand-written template engine for Moss. She rejected the idea: not worth the maintenance. Moss keeps Jinja2.
## Evidence and limits
Her decision, stated on 14 April 2026.
## Recheck when
She raises it again.

title: Pandoc 管道太慢，放弃了（2026 年 1 月）
body:
## Knowledge
2026 年 1 月林薇试过用 Pandoc 做 Moss 的 Markdown 管道，每次全量构建要 90 秒，放弃了。现在用 `markdown-it-py` 加 footnote 插件。
## Evidence and limits
用户说的。
## Recheck when
Pandoc 性能有变化，或者文章数量变化。

title: No analytics and no comments on Moss
body:
## Knowledge
Moss has no analytics: Google Analytics and Plausible were both rejected in March 2026 for reader privacy. There is no comment system either.
## Evidence and limits
Her decision.
## Recheck when
She asks for reader statistics.

title: Moss output directory: _site (until May 2026)
body:
## Knowledge
Until May 2026 Moss wrote its build output to `_site/`.
## Evidence and limits
